name: Quiet Time
summary: A clock opens into a pause. A bright, modern identity for an app that protects prayer time.
why: The familiar clock carries the prayer schedule. Its open corner becomes a pause symbol, connecting timekeeping to the app's automatic silence during prayer. Acid yellow gives the mark a confident presence among conventional prayer icons.
risk: Without the app name, the mark could read as a focus timer. The silence feature is more prominent than Quran reading.
